newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: COSTA RICA JULY INFLATION RISES SLIGHTLY FROM JUNE.
newsitem.headline: COSTA RICA JULY INFLATION RISES SLIGHTLY FROM JUNE.

text.p: Inflation in Costa Rica was 0.86 percent in July, slightly above the 0.78 percent increase in consumer prices posted in June, the government said on Thursday.

Accumulated inflation from January to July was 7.49 percent compared with 9.07 percent in the same period last year, the Ministry of the Economy, Industry and Trade, Jose Leon Desanti, said at a news conference.
Inflation was 13.28 percent higher in July this year than in the same month a year earlier.
